essence: The verse declares paśu-drinking to be hell-giving and names its fruit.
Paśu-drinking is to be practiced only for a limited time, then surpassed.
Drinking liquor beyond the proper limit leads to a fall.
Drinking the substance up to the throat liberates, without doubt.
Through this practice rebirth is not found.
